best_hook.why: Thug swings a club full force and the scarred soldier catches it bare-handed mid-air: instant scroll-stopping power move.

best_cliffhanger.why: Right after the thug screams 'Gerald Harrington paid us!', Juliana's heartbroken 'Gerald...' turns the name into a betrayal by someone she trusted; cut before any fallout.

must_promos.why: Bare-hand catch, three thugs flattened, choke-lift interrogation 'Who sent you?' / 'Wrong answer.', then the mastermind's name and the wife's devastated reaction - full arc of power fantasy plus betrayal reveal in 40 s.

standalone_risk: A stranger does not know who Gerald Harrington is or why he would pay to wreck a garden; Juliana's 'Gerald...' signals betrayal but not the relationship. Why thugs target her garden is also unexplained.
notes: Opening the cut at the catch skips the 'Move aside, soldier' setup; Juliana's injured reaction shots during the fight supply who is being protected.
